events.title: We're working with Keita Takahashi!

events.title: Test the new demo!
events.summary: Just a quick note to say that there's a new beta of the Reality Drift demo! This is a major update to the demo from last year, with two new missions and many improvements.To try the new version, make sure you switch to the beta branch via the demo's properties menu in Steam. events.title: Feb 2026 Update!
events.summary: Hi dudes! We're still hard at work on the game, and we've also been demoing it at various events in the last few months. Most notably, we were at EGX last year, where we had the honour of meeting Hornet, from Hollow Knight: Silksong.If you're in Yorkshire, UK, this week the game is available to play at the Yorkshire Games Festival in Bradford. events.title: Demo and Tiny Teams!
events.summary: We're excited to announce that the Reality Drift demo, which has just been released, is part of the Tiny Teams festival!Tiny Teams is a festival all about celebrating games made by solo developers and micro-studios, from already popular indie hits, to hidden gems and what could be the next "big thing.”The Tiny Teams 2025 festival will run from 7th-14th of August on Steam!
